price_note: Every price read at full resolution from photographs of the shop's own window board and its handwritten topping card, both dated 2026-04 — the most recent menu photographs that exist for this shop. Prices are as printed. This is a 立ち食い standing-noodle counter: order and pay at the window, eat standing, no reservations. Cash for the handwritten seasonal tempura. Every noodle order is そば or うどん at the same price — say which when you order.

items.en: The plain bowl — noodles in hot broth with spring onion and nothing else. Choose soba or udon
items.note: 立ち食いそばの麺は小麦つなぎが標準、つゆも小麦醤油と鰹だし。Standing-soba noodles are wheat-bound even when called soba, and the tsuyu is wheat soy sauce with bonito dashi. Nothing here is gluten-free.

items.ja: 天ぷら（かきあげ）（そば・うどん）
items.en: With a kakiage fritter — the shredded-vegetable tempura patty dropped on top so it slowly dissolves into the broth
items.note: 衣＝小麦、共用フライヤー、つゆ＝小麦醤油。Wheat batter, shared fryer, wheat broth.

items.ja: 天玉（かきあげ、生玉子）（そば・うどん）
items.en: Kakiage plus a raw egg cracked into the bowl — the standing-counter's idea of luxury for ¥80 more
items.note: 衣＝小麦、卵あり。Wheat batter plus raw egg.

items.en: Tanuki — with crunchy tenkasu, the loose batter crumbs left over from frying tempura
items.note: 天かす＝小麦の衣くず。Tenkasu is literally fried wheat batter.

items.en: Kitsune — with a sheet of sweet-simmered fried tofu
items.note: 油揚げの煮汁は醤油・みりん＝小麦、つゆも鰹だし。The aburaage is simmered in soy and mirin; the broth is bonito. Not vegan despite looking it.

items.en: Tsukimi ('moon-viewing') — a raw egg dropped whole into the bowl, yolk sitting like a moon
items.note: 麺・つゆとも小麦、卵あり。

items.ja: コロッケ（そば・うどん）
items.en: Korokke soba — a whole potato croquette dropped on the noodles, where it collapses into the broth. A Tokyo standing-counter institution
items.note: コロッケの衣はパン粉＝小麦。Panko-crumbed croquette.

items.note: 衣＝小麦、ちくわ自体にも小麦でんぷんが入ることが多い。Wheat batter, and chikuwa itself is often bound with wheat starch.

items.en: With mountain vegetables — the seasoned wild greens
